excluded_from_denominator: Network sending, signed transport, admission queues, storage and retransmission
accounting.interpretation: Measured actual H=4 public-prefix forgery under known challenge, not a fastest adversary lower bound or infinite replay amortization. Do not sum the five verification paths into one receiver cost; current production and explicit FullLimb are aliases.
overhead_not_unavoidable_attacker_cost: Trial hex formatting and trial-vector retention
The exact unoptimized two-hash implementation and four-search horizon
accounting.per_class_denominator: A = sum(cohort.total.cpu_ns for the 8 real cohorts); contains 8 actual prefix setup calls and all 32 real searches, including misses, challenge hashes, trial retention and winning-buffer clones.
accounting.per_class_numerator: V_path = sum(verifier.timing.cpu_ns for all actual candidates of this class on one named path).
accounting.reported_ratio: V_path / A, only with at least one candidate and all recorded outcomes for that path equal Transcript.
accounting.wall_clock: Raw setup/search/cohort/verifier wall_ns are separately summed and retained. Never divide a wall numerator by CPU denominator.

budgets.hosted_job_scope: Shared across checkout/source guards, original tests/lints, original default false-trace mode and additional full-limb mode; not a dedicated 55-minute full-limb allowance.

commands.source_note: The native selector is the only accepted native argument in this mode. --full-limb is the Python owner flag, not the native selector.

construction: w1_from_zero::proof_prefix calls task_id(a,b), writes PNW1 and canonical public A/B, then resizes the entire proof to zero C and zero claimed transcript; it never computes A*B or obtains a legal transcript.
false_search iterates nonce 0..4096, calculates the two hashes, retains every trial and stops only at the first ticket <= fixed target or full exhaustion.
On a target hit, it clones the actual prepared full prefix buffer and replaces the last 32 bytes with the fabricated trace; the clone is inside search timing.
cohort constructs one actual prefix and performs four measured searches using different source-derived challenges before stopping its inclusive total clock.
Shared w1_cost_producers contributes Clock/Timing/Search/Trial/Winner/raw/hash helpers; its legal Producer definitions are not invoked by this campaign.

checks: Exact nine material recipes and canonical full bytes/task IDs
Fixed seed/target/8 samples/four searches/4096 cap/5 verifier paths
Consecutive nonce recipe, false trace and ticket hashes, first-hit stop, every 4096 miss for exhaustion
Complete forged candidate proof bytes/SHA and challenge
Exactly one actual setup per cohort and zero setup calls per search
Positive actual CPU/wall and inclusive total >= setup+all searches
Actual verifier invocation order, path, proof identity and Transcript outcomes
Complete end record, exact 72 cohorts and 288 searches, observed candidate/verifier counts, at least one actual rejected candidate

exit_codes.0: complete consistent capture without semantic alerts
exit_codes.1: complete capture with native verdict alert

remaining_limits: Task matrices are fixed public synthetic recipes and challenges are primitive microbenchmark contexts, not current network parent/lease/beneficiary bindings.

No source-only observation or parser exit proves that C4 bytes compiled/executed; independent before/after full tracked-byte guards, original config/locked graph, actual ELF, process terminal/raw hashes remain required.
Same forged candidate is invoked on five comparison paths; this is not evidence that public admission repeats every request or that a network attacker pays four setups per four submissions.
Material generation includes full-rank construction even for a whole campaign containing cheap zero classes; it must not be charged as unavoidable zero-task attack work.
Hash midstate reuse, a longer actual horizon and optimized trial handling can make attacks cheaper. Measured H4 cost is neither a minimum nor a proof of service liveness.
Unexpected acceptance, early rejection, incomplete coverage, timeout or reader failure must remain failed evidence, not be filtered from ratios.
scope: Read-only exact-source review of the original --full-limb mode; no execution, no measurement and no frozen source change.

verification.path: All input/field/task/ticket checks precede full transcript replay. False claims should fail Transcript after replay and before product corrections. This is relation-level verification with no fact cache, no live node admission.
verification.unexpected_outcomes: Retained as semantic_alerts; original runner FAIL, standalone reader exit 1.
